targets.title: Anatomy, physiology, and levels of organization
targets.description: 1.a Differentiate key foundational concepts in anatomy and physiology, including the distinction between the two fields and terms related to the organization of the human body.

targets.title: Anatomical position, directions, planes, and regions
targets.description: 1.b Describe the structural orientation of the human body, including anatomical position, directional terms, major planes, axial and appendicular regions, and positional terminology.

targets.title: Body cavities and serous membranes
targets.description: 1.c Identify major body cavities and their subdivisions, along with the associated serous membranes and the fluids within each cavity.

targets.title: Abdominopelvic quadrants and regions
targets.description: 1.d Describe major regions of the abdominopelvic area, including the quadrants, nine abdominal regions, and methods used to subdivide the abdominal region.

targets.title: Homeostasis
targets.description: 1.e Explain the concept of homeostasis.

targets.title: Negative and positive feedback
targets.description: 1.f Differentiate between negative and positive feedback systems.

targets.title: Structure of an atom
targets.description: 2.a Describe the structure of an atom.

targets.title: Atoms, molecules, compounds, ions, and isotopes
targets.description: 2.b Distinguish among atoms, molecules, compounds, ions, and isotopes.

targets.title: Chemical bonds
targets.description: 2.c Explain the major types of chemical bonding.

targets.title: Water, oxygen, carbon dioxide, and pH
targets.description: 2.d Explain the functions and importance of the body's major inorganic compounds, including water, oxygen, and carbon dioxide.

targets.title: Organic compounds
targets.description: 2.e Describe the body's major organic compounds and their functions.

targets.title: Enzymes
targets.description: 2.f Explain the role enzymes play in cellular processes.

targets.title: Cytoplasm and organelles
targets.description: 3.a Define cytoplasm and organelle.

targets.title: Organelle structure and function
targets.description: 3.b Describe the structure, function and relationship of all cell organelles.

targets.title: The cell membrane
targets.description: 3.c Describe the structure of the cell membrane.

targets.title: Membrane transport
targets.description: 3.d Describe the different modes of transport of substances across cell membranes.

targets.title: Microscopic anatomy of tissues
targets.description: 4.a Identify the microscopic anatomy of body tissues.

targets.title: Characteristics of tissue types
targets.description: 4.b List the characteristics of each tissue type.

targets.title: Functions of tissue types
targets.description: 4.c List the functions of each tissue type.

targets.title: Locations of tissue types
targets.description: 4.d Give examples of the locations of each tissue type in the body.
